subject: ist-f
title: (R)IST.F.------TR.INFO.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-25 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's argument that 'institutionalized prodding' (university dominance) suppresses inquiry: 'the nature of being is suppressed — which is to say, both creative and functional information routes are perceived in accordance to the established power structure dictates.' (R)IST-F (the reality of interior-source functionalism) is crossed with TR-INFO (transfer information): the question is what interior-source-functionalism produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with transfer-information — the (R) prefix marking that interior-source-functionalism must actually obtain to resist institutional suppression. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) feeds in from the upper-left. RT-INT-TR (reality-interior traits) sits between subject and partner. TR-INFO is the partner. AFL (affinity alignment) anchors the upper-right output. ATTN (attention) sits below the subject as a central hub. TH-CONT-DY (theoretical-continuance dynamics) hangs on the right output. (P)INTR (point-of-activation interior) and AF-CON (affinity contact) form the lower-center cluster. Structural argument: interior-source-functionalism-as-real crossed with transfer-information is mediated by reality-interior-traits (the natural intersection between interior and exterior). The (p) prefix on INTR registers that interior in this configuration is triggered rather than continuous — Braxton's diagnostic that institutional prodding makes interior-life intermittent. Attention as the lower hub is load-bearing: it is what gets captured by 'four thousand books' (the prose example), and the diagram exposes that real interior-source-functionalism must route around the captured-attention hub to reach affinity-alignment.
